verdict.rationale: Probes confirm Resend serves a live llms.txt at resend.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) and markdown versions of its docs. Those docs carry an agent-directed index pointing to a complete docs/llms.txt, and the llms.txt content itself is agent-oriented, covering MCP setup, the CLI, batch sending and domain verification. missing for 10: independent community or hands-on reports of agents actually consuming these docs successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://resend.com/llms.txt # Resend
Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://resend.com/docs/llms.txt
Add Resend to Cursor, Claude, and other MCP clients.
verify domains (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), rotate API keys, configure webhooks, and monitor delivery events.
